name: Witch Doctor: Malice-line passives modify Hex of Malice and the Jinx family (#2297, #2886)
contract: Prolonged Malice 704505 (#2297): effect0 aura 107 (ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER), MiscValue 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION), BasePoints 5999 + DieSides 1 = 6000 ms, EffectSpellClassMask (0, 33554432, 0) matching exactly Hex of Malice's (501153) own SpellFamilyFlags word1 = 33554432. effect1 aura 107, MiscValue 5 (SPELLMOD_RANGE), BasePoints 5 + 1 = 6 yd, class mask (263432, 33850368, 32), whose word0 bit 262144 and word2 bit 32 both match Lethargy Jinx's (802065) SpellFamilyFlags [262144, 4096, 32]; word1 does not match Lethargy Jinx (4096), so the duration mod must not touch it. Zalazane's Malice 705902 (#2886): effect0 aura 108 (ADD_PCT_MODIFIER), MiscValue 22 (SPELLMOD_DOT), BasePoints 14 + 1 = 15%, class mask (0, 33554432, 0) again exactly Hex of Malice's word1; effect1 aura 108, MiscValue 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION), BasePoints 1999 + 1 = 2000 ms, class mask (0, 0, 32) exactly Lethargy Jinx's word2 (the Jinx family bit); Hex of Malice's own word2 is 0, so this duration mod must not touch it. Player::ApplySpellMod (Player.cpp) / AuraEffect::CalculateSpellMod (SpellAuraEffects.cpp) apply these generically; SPELLMOD_DOT is read in Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone for every periodic tick. spell_modifier reads each mod against a fixed synthetic base without casting. Regression guard for behaviour that already works natively; no module code touches either spell.

steps.label: BASELINE: Hex of Malice duration unmodified before Prolonged Malice
BASELINE: Hex of Malice DoT damage unmodified before Zalazane's Malice
BASELINE: Lethargy Jinx range unmodified before Prolonged Malice
Prolonged Malice adds 6 sec to Hex of Malice's duration (#2297)
Prolonged Malice adds 6 yd range to Lethargy Jinx as an offensive Voodoo spell (#2297)
CONTROL: Prolonged Malice's duration clause does not reach Lethargy Jinx (word1 flags differ)
Zalazane's Malice adds 15% DoT damage to Hex of Malice (#2886)
Zalazane's Malice adds 2 sec to Lethargy Jinx's duration as a Jinx (#2886)
CONTROL: Hex of Malice's duration stays at Prolonged Malice's +6 sec only, Zalazane's Malice duration clause targets Jinxes, not Hex of Malice
CONTROL: Lethargy Jinx has no DoT-damage mod (word1 flags differ from Hex of Malice's)
